## NXH to participate in Wedbush Fireside Chat on September 9, 2026


09/08/2026


[Download (opens in new window) PDF 96 KB](https://s203.q4cdn.com/409549452/files/doc_news/NXH-to-participate-in-Wedbush-Fireside-Chat-on-September-9-2026-2026.pdf)


NASHVILLE, Tenn.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Neighborhood Intelligence, Inc. (Nasdaq: NXH) (“Neighborhood Intelligence” or the “Company”) today announced that Executive Chairman Marcus Lemonis is scheduled to participate in a fireside chat with Wedbush Securities on Wednesday, Sept. 9, 2026, at approximately 10:30 a.m. Eastern Time.


To participate in the live webinar, please contactequitycorporateaccess@wedbush.com


A replay of the webinar will be available at[https://investors.beyond.com/news-events/events-and-presentations/default.aspx](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.beyond.com%2Fnews-events%2Fevents-and-presentations%2Fdefault.aspx&esheet=54599993&newsitemid=20260908595710&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.beyond.com%2Fnews-events%2Fevents-and-presentations%2Fdefault.aspx&index=1&md5=01cc1facc8932c391d99dcbeff32415e) approximately two hours after the event.


**About Neighborhood**


Neighborhood Intelligence (Nasdaq: NXH), previously Bed Bath & Beyond, Inc., is a data and technology company organized around three interconnected pillars: Omni-Channel Retail, Home Services and Home Ownership.


Its portfolio includes Bed Bath & Beyond, Overstock, buybuy BABY, Kirkland’s, The Container Store, Elfa and Closet Works, along with its expanding Home Services and Home Ownership businesses. Neighborhood connects products, services, financing, expertise and data to make homeownership simpler and more affordable.
